ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Peace be on Abraham' signify in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this verse is frequently recited during the Tashahhud of prayer, linking the believer's daily worship to the legacy of the Patriarchs. It underscores Ibrahim's status as a Hanif (pure monotheist) and a model of submission, reinforcing the continuity of divine guidance through the Prophets.
